title: Implement canonical cursor pagination
prompt: Implement encodeCursor and decodeCursor in src/cursor.js and paginate in src/pagination.js, then re-export all three functions from src/index.js. Use ES modules and only Node built-ins. encodeCursor(offset) requires a non-negative safe integer and returns the unpadded base64url encoding of the UTF-8 decimal string; for example 0 encodes as 'MA' and 10 encodes as 'MTA'. decodeCursor(cursor) requires exactly a string produced by encodeCursor: it returns the original non-negative safe integer and throws an Error for a non-string, an empty string, or any non-canonical or malformed cursor. paginate(items, options = {}) requires an array and returns { items, nextCursor, hasMore }. The optional limit defaults to 10 and must be an integer from 1 through 100 inclusive. The optional cursor defaults to null; when present it must be a string accepted by decodeCursor and its number is the zero-based start offset. Return at most limit items starting at that offset. nextCursor must be encodeCursor(offset + returned item count) when more input remains, otherwise null; hasMore must be true exactly when nextCursor is not null. A cursor equal to or beyond the array length returns an empty page with null nextCursor and false hasMore. Do not mutate items, options, or any cursor, and reject invalid arguments with an Error.
